body:
SKETCH v1 is posted on STORY-1887: `aida pr ship-batch <N...>`. It is human-TTY only. For each PR, in the given order: refresh (update-branch only when behind or stale), wait for CI, wait for an approval at the exact head via the ship gate's own reader, then a typed TTY confirmation, then an in-process ship with no overrides.
Every failure stops the batch without shipping. Re-runs are idempotent because already-merged PRs are skipped, so there is no resume file. Reviews are enqueued and awaited, never recorded or carried over. It is one PR, with fake-port unit tests T1–T8.
Three questions: Q1, add pr_ship_batch.rs to GATE_PROTECTED_PATHS? Q2, fold hold-clear into the confirmation? Q3, should a review timeout stop the batch rather than skip the PR? No code until you sign off.
subject: SKETCH posted (STORY-1887)
